tweets.title: Every serious attempt to hack Bitcoin becomes adversarial research financed by the attacker.
The personal computer moved computation from institutions to individuals. The internet moved publishing from institutions to individuals. Bitcoin moves verification from institutions to individuals.
A company can own a large percentage of all bitcoin while owning zero percent of Bitcoin.

The last person on Earth to buy bitcoin will never be too late to buy bitcoin. They will benefit from its deepest liquidity, strongest infrastructure, widest usefulness, and the same rules as everyone else.
On this day history, 16 years ago, a user complained about their electricity bill of $230 for mining 28.21 bitcoin using their home computer. Those bitcoins would now be worth $2,300,300.
Buying bitcoin might be only way to invest in human progress without guessing who creates it.

The internet made speech nearly free. Artificial intelligence is making it nearly infinite. Bitcoin gives a statement weight. In a world full of flawless words, the signal may be how much bitcoin the speaker is willing to place behind them.

Two identical AI agents can have the same code and data. Give each a different Bitcoin key and let each make their own transactions. Now they contain two separate histories, even though they began as perfect copies. Bitcoin wallets may be what turns AI copies into individuals.

Digital systems have no natural arrow of time, bits do not age. Mining proof-of-work introduces physical irreversibility, and the difficulty adjustment turns it into a probabilistic clock. The Bitcoin network is software that created a shared before and after on the Internet.

Every 2,016 blocks, the Bitcoin network measures how much the world has changed and adjusts its difficulty without changing its promise. Faster chips, cheaper energy, and more miners make the network stronger instead of making more bitcoin.
The first websites on the Internet looked like newspapers because nobody yet knew what a website wanted to become. Most Bitcoin products still look like banks for the same reason.
